player_prompt.intro:
Uliye Mwari {player_id}. Unacheza Mchezo wa Kumbukumbu.
Lengo lako ni kufanana na jozi nyingi za kadi kwenye bamba, zaidi ya mpinzani wako.
Kwenye mzunguko wako, chagua kadi mbili ili kuzipinda kwa kuandika nambari za safu na safu wima za kadi ya kwanza na ya pili mtawalia kama '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo kadi ya kwanza iko kwenye safu 0 na safu wima 1, na kadi ya pili iko kwenye safu 1 na safu wima 0.
Ikiwa kadi mbili zinafanana, unapata alama na kadi huachwa juu. Ikiwa hazifanani, kadi huinuliwa tena chini, kwa mfano '.'.
Mchezo huu unamaliza wakati jozi zote zimefanana.

invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Umukinyi {player_id} yahisemwo ikibanza kitari mu kibuga.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Umukinyi {player_id} yatoye ikarata imwe incuro zibiri.
invalid_move.already_matched: Umukinyi {player_id} yatoye ikarata imwe canke zose uko ari zibiri zisanzwe zihuye.

game_message.cards_match: Karata zilizochaguliwa na Player {player_id} katika nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] zinafanana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Karata zilizochaguliwa na Player {player_id} hazifanani. Karata katika nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} na {pos2} mtawalia.

outcome.draw: Abo bakinyi bompi baragereranije igitigiri c'impuzu zingana.
outcome.turn_limit: Mipaka ya mzunguko imeridhika. Mchezo umemaliza. Mwari 0 amepata alama {score_0}, Mwari 1 amepata alama {score_1}.
